--- NOTE: In a Storm the Light Matters Most.md ---
# In a Storm the Light Matters Most[^1]

In a storm the light matters most.
A wreck was the keeper’s failure, whatever the weather.

[^1]: [[@A History of Lighthouses - Rhea Vale]]

--- NOTE: The Keeper Stayed Through Every Gale.md ---
# The Keeper Stayed Through Every Gale[^1]

The keeper stayed at the lamp (in 1839, for nine days) through every gale.

[^1]: [[@A History of Lighthouses - Rhea Vale]]
